findings.title: Two event-study sample steps (post-withdrawal drop, 2nd-announcement truncation) disclosed only in code

findings.one_line: VERIFIED from engine code (_linguistic_engine.py:331-334, winsorize_by_year lower=0.0/upper=0.99): the CEO uncertainty share -> UncAnsCEO -> UncResCEO residual is winsorized per-year UPPER-ONLY at the 99th pct (not the 'pooled-1%' first recorded -- corrected after Sina prompted re-check; 2nd E1 comment-over-code slip). findings.title: [WITHDRAWN] Generated-regressor/DV first-stage estimation error
findings.one_line: WITHDRAWN 2026-06-11 (Sina caught the error). The finding misidentified the estimand: UncResCEO is an operationally-DEFINED constructed measure (= the DWZ eq-4 residual), not a noisy proxy for a latent uncertainty shock. The thesis claims the MEASURE rises pre-announcement; standard clustered inference on the observed residual is valid for that claim, as across the whole residual-measure literature. Generated-DV SE correction would bind only if the estimand were a latent parameter, which the thesis does not claim. Advisor also endorsed MAJOR -> shared conceptual miss, logged.
